description.value: Strand Book Store is an independent bookstore located at 828 Broadway near Union Square. The store is known for its slogan 18 Miles Of Books, covering new, used and rare titles. It is an easy browse for an hour between Greenwich Village and Union Square. Yelp lists the shop with 1818 Reviews - 828 Broadway, New York.
